scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,web,api,worker --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace @factorylens/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace @factorylens/web" "npm run dev --workspace @factorylens/api" "uv run --project apps/worker factorylens-worker"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @factorylens/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @factorylens/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @factorylens/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @factorylens/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @factorylens/contracts && npm run build --workspace @factorylens/web && npm run build --workspace @factorylens/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @factorylens/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && uv run --project apps/worker mypy --config-file apps/worker/pyproject.toml apps/worker/src apps/worker/tests
scripts.lint: eslint . && markdownlint-cli2 "*.md" ".github/**/*.md" && uv run --project apps/worker ruff check apps/worker/src apps/worker/tests
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json package-lock.json eslint.config.js tsconfig.base.json apps/web apps/api packages/contracts operations && uv run --project apps/worker ruff format apps/worker/src apps/worker/tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json package-lock.json eslint.config.js tsconfig.base.json apps/web apps/api packages/contracts operations && uv run --project apps/worker ruff format --check apps/worker/src apps/worker/tests
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @factorylens/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && uv run --project apps/worker pytest -c apps/worker/pyproject.toml apps/worker/tests
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
